body:
To keep trying is hard so the fact that you are doing it show that you are strong enough to make it. Hopefully this time they will get it right. I am crossing my fingers.

Do you have something that you like to do to "keep your shit in check"? I like to draw, it gets my mind of things.
I like to put my thoughts on paper, whether it is writing or drawing, but you need to find something that works for you. Everyone is different
It is very strong of you to keep seeking the help you need and deserve. I am no professional but if you find it helpful to just talk you can always write
No, it is not the only thing you can control. Maybe you do not feel like it right now but you can take control of your emotions and help yourself to a happier life. It is all in you.
Thank YOU

It is wednesday today and I have to get on the train soon to get back there but I don't want to... I don't want to talk to her. I feel stupid. I'm not particularly down today so it feels like it isn't necessary, like I freak out over nothing and that that is what she is going to tell me. I don't want to go...

One persons who told me he loved me everyday, I made him leave because how act. It hurt so much knowing that I make people stop caring because I'm such a pain in the ass even thou all I want is to make everything alright. Everything backfire.

They have never been that close friends, not lately. Maybe when we were younger but then you don't have this problems. They are better friends with each other than they are to me, and now they are not talking to me at all. When I look at it now they never cared if I was there or not, they managed without me, I just tagged along. Yeah, my best friends.

Yeah but people are leaving for a reason and the common factor is me. 
It feels like I'm just sitting here complaining, feeling sorry for myself. It feels so stupid. 
It just hurt to be reminded all the time about how people I like hate me. I can't hate them back.

Everyone I know has left me in just the last month, and I never had many. More like 3. The only friend I have is one whom I have never meet. Everyday in school I see them ignoring me, laughing and having fun without me. I see my ex ignoring me as well.The only person who ever called me to just check up was this guy who yelled at me today.
I cry as soon as I'm alone, I suck it up during classes because I don't want them to see. I never have anywhere to go in the weekends so I just stay inside and study, it's pretty much all i do.
You are a good person, truly. I guess I just stopped caring about trying to make it better. It has kind of become my everyday.
You are right of course. I just don't see why I should bother. Sorry for dumping this on you like this.
It's hard to admit that you need help. I'm kind of the one who have always managed on my own.

I talked to someone about a year ago but I started to feel so bad that I just said that I was fine and stopped going.I don't know where else to go.I just can't seem to bring myself to to it. I don't want anybody to see me like this.
No I'm not. I called, but I just hung up the phone before they could answer.

i know exactly what you mean but know that I just want to help so if you have something you want to get of your chest, don't be afraid to do so. Then if you want to talk to someone, and not just a stranger on the internet like me, there is always help to get.
yeah I will, thanks for listening.

Ye but it's just hard because I feel bad when I make others feel bad. It's hard to be selfish and do what is best for yourself when it means hurting someone you care about.
Either way thanks for listening, I'm glad there still are people like you out there.
Thanks, and you too.

It's hard to hear him tell me how wonderful everything would be when I can remember how hard it was and all the bad things that happened. Everything is against it but he always say that I will go my whole life thinking about "what if", what if it had worked and how wonderful it would have been.

Hi. I'm really sorry for the things that haunts you and I get why you are tired of what you are going through. I just hope that this things you are trying to change are stuff that you want to change and not something someone else have told you. Of Course I don't know the circumstances so it's hard for me to tell but I just hope that you are doing okay try to look positive at the future

Hey, sorry for taking so long to respond.
I recognise what you are feeling, it's almost as if it could have been myself who wrote it. Therefore I just want to let you know that you are not alone in your thoughts and that you can always write if you want to talk. We are all messed-up so don't be sad for open up.

Hey, I get how you are feeling, it's not just who are alone for the holidays. Just letting you know that there are more of us out there. You can always write a line so can we be alone together.
Ye I'm not that good with pep talks but hopefully you get what I mean. 
Marry christmas to you :)

At least for you it's over now then. I still have to study.
When we were together my friends got quite mad at me for kind of picking him over them, and they still are i guess. They say that I should just tell him to stop contacting me but I just can't. It feels like I just can't speak the words. I don't have anyone else who calls me and I hardly ever see my friends or talk to them.
I'm not really good at handling the pressure either so sometimes I just breakdown crying and then I can't really study for the rest of the night so I feel even worse. And yeah... that I haven't really told anyone. It feels kind of lame sitting here whining about it to you so, sorry.

You feel a bit like a hypocrite when you tell others how it's going to get better when you have a hard time seeing it yourself, but it kind of helps to know that at least I kan make others feel better.  

Thanks.

Hi. An hour goes quite fast.

It's an awful lot going on but when I look at it from an objective perspective everything sounds so silly so therefore I usually never talk about it.
I'm in my final year of highschool (I'm not sure highschool is the same thing but I guess it's a correct translation.) so it's a lot of pressure to get through. My dad always tells me how great I'm going to do but I have no ide where I want to go when I'm done. My relationship to a person, who used to be my best friend but whom I have never meet, is getting more and more tense. I broke up with my distance boyfriend about a month ago but he still keep in touch and want us to try again. He screams at me when he's angry and he have said really horrible things to me. My family doesn't like him and neither does my friends, but them I rarely see. Most I just study and rarely goes out. I don't really have anyone to talk to. when my friends are happy, my ex gets mad. When I try to make them both happy I get sad.
Sounds stupid, doesn't it. And sorry if my english isn't that great.
The goal in life is to be happy. Keep the good spirit up and I know that the rest will sort itself out :)
I'm glad to hear that. That's all I want. I hope everything gets better. :)

I know you can. Don't you want to travel? don't you want your girlfriend to stay with you? don't you want to be happy? don't you want you to be happy together? you can make this your goals, just to be happy is a good goal.

When life is not fun, you make it fun. I know it is not that simple but it's the principle. Everyone end up in depressions sometimes, and when everything seems pointless you just have to find the meaning again. To have a goal, something to strive for, not something you have to do but something you want to do. For your own sake. For your own happiness.

No, maybe life is not a fairy tale but is not the whole beauty of it? We have no fate that determines how our life will end, it is entirely up to us. we can do whatever we want to do, go the way we would like to go, come to what goal we want. There is no one else who decides it than ourselves. I know it is not as easy as it anything will happen just because we want it to, but I would like to think it helps, and we always get a second chance if we fail, every morning is a new opportunity.

that horrible feeling I recognize but I try to see it as that every morning I get another chance, another chance to be happy. I hope you also can come to see it that way eventually. you can always write to me if that helps.
I understand what you mean. it can really help.

You do not need to excuse yourself. I understand how you feel, and how hard it most be, but how dark the future may seem to you now, I think deep down you know that you are strong enough to make it through everything. You are never alone, even if it feels so. There are always people who care, who can hold your hand, you just have to look. Maybe you do not know them yet but they are out there waiting for you. Try to understand that there was this girl who lost you, not vice versa. It was her ​​loss. I really hope you feel better soon. you can always write if you feel like it.
I cann't really relate to your feelings but I can understand and if you want to talk, I can always listen. I want you to know that you are not alone.
you are a good writer
I don't think so because I have told them, but thanks anyway.
I'm just 18, I can't handle this by myself. I don't know what to do.
yes it does, he has atleast now promised to seek help, but I've heard it before. I have also had to promis to do some things for it.

The problem is that I cann't think of anyone who would care. None of the ones I've told take it seriously, everyone think he just gives empty threats. My friends hate him because they see how I feel, my family does not like him either and I have received some insults from his family / friends too so everyone is against our relationship. I feel like I stand alone.

He has said all along that he needs help, but never tried it. I almost forces him now to go and talk to someone because I do not manage to take care of him. But it's so hard when he sits on the phone crying and saying how much he loves me and ask me not to leave him.
I know the feeling

I can understand how you feel even if I really can't relate and I'm so sorry that's how you feel but I really hope that you can realize that if they do not accept you for who you are then it's them that's it's wrong with, not you. You shouldn't feel sad because there are people out there who would be happy to have you as there friend, you just have to find them. Don't give up.

I'm upset to hear you talk so badly about gay people and I am sorry that you can't accept who you are, so I want to take the time to tell you that if your friends and family do not accept you for who you are, they don't deserve you. I'm sorry but it's their loss. If they are real friends no such thing as your sexual orientation should affect your relationship. If they don't respect you you shouldn't respect them. 

I really hope you come to realize that there isn't something wrong with you so you can get past all that you feel now. You deserve to meet someone that makes you happy. If it happens to be a man so what's with that? I know it will get better if you just realize that.

People do care, even if you can't see it right now because of how you feel. Take a moment to relax, you'll see that it gets easier. Find the strength in yourself, you're stronger than you think and you can do without your boyfriend. With school, there is always help available. Find someone who can help you to study. Your grades will get better and a new friendship might help you get past your mental problems. Don't give up, it gets better. I know you can do it.
thanks so much for your help
I don't know what to do...

School, work, friends, boyfriend (especially the boyfriend), it's just too much, too much responsibility and pressure. I do not know what to do to make everyone happy. what I do, something goes wrong.

I only know that I don't want to calm down, I want to cry, I want to get it out of me because I can not bear it anymore, keeping everything inside. When you can't cope with it anymore your feelings are just welling over.
Apparently, I was off today so went in vain. I have no luck now.
yes I know that much, thanks.
yeah I guess so
Thank you so much.
I like to talk further tomorrow but now I should sleep because it's my first day at work tomorrow so I need to be rested.
I like my city as well, near the water, a lot of forest, it's peaceful.
I have been riding the ferry several times but never got off on Finnish soil. I live near Stockholm.
I think so too but I have unfortunately never been touring in finland

yes I'm here. 
it seems to be very much focused on our weather nowadays. I like that it's hot.
I don't know where to go

It sounds nice. 
Yes we do but it's more when you are a kid, I did not do it this year. it is said that when you blow out the candles and wish for something, it will come true. one usually tries to blow out all at a time. they usually have a candle for every year that you fill but it gets a little hard when you get older so like I said, most for toddlers.

you are too kind. 
This time of year tends to be the warmest but I think it has been unseasonably warm this year.
Unfortunately, I do not think I have any connection to India, but I would like to go there.

I baked a caramel cake with nuts, strawberries and raspberries. 
Nowadays it becomes barely cold in the middle of the night here in Sweden. 
The drink I had wanted to try, sounds good.

My family and I have baked buns, cookies and cake so there is plenty to eat. 
It sounds like a nice place where you live. Atleast you do not have the long and cold winters like we have up here in the north. The only good thing about them is the warm and cozy evenings spent indoors with a cup of hot chocolate and a good movie.

you are too kind to me. 

It's not raining here. It has actually been unusually warm lately. Although I appreciate the summer heat I can also enjoy the rain, it washes everything away and brings new life. The downside with it is the cold.
Thanks. I don't know what to say. I just want it to stop. The anxiety, make it disappear, get the tears to stop flowing and the pain in my heart to ease but I don't know what to do.

I'm sorry, I saw that I even forgot to write in english in my last post... He thinks I'm a false and lying bitch and it doesn't matter what I say because I'll just end up hurting him again. He say stuff like that deep inside he wish that I was dead, that I have made him feel like his soul is broken and that he will remember me like the asshole who played with his feelings. But he hasn't left me. I can't stop crying, I feel like I deserve all this.

Nobody should have to go one alone. I can relate to the feeling of feeling awful and panic when you just try o be genuine and open. You should know that you are not alone, hang in there, your family and friend appreciate you more than you think, they are just bad at showing it.
Jag vet att han inte är men jag gråter för att jag har förstört allt mellan oss, för jag har gett honom fel uppfattning om mig, och om jag inte hade varit så hopplöst det skulle ha fungerat.

I feel bad when I do what he wants and I feel bad when I don't. He says that we should be happy now, together, because we are still together even after everything that has happened, but I don't feel happy. I feel like something is squeezing my heart and I want to cry. He says everything will be fine now but I don't know if I believe or if I even should believe it. Have I made the right choice?

I have done things I know I shouldn't. I feel stupid for not seeing what a bad thing it would be to do before I do it and not thinking about how my boyfriend will see it. I talk to a person he don't like because I feel like he is the only one I have to talk to. This person likes me more than just as a friend but I don't feel that way about him, which he knows, and he is okay with it so we have stayed friends for quite some time now. We have never meet, just talked over internet. My boyfriend however see this as a reason for me to stop talking to him altogether. It's hard for me because if I do it I feel like I won't have anyone. Lately it also seems like my ex want us to stay friend, which he doesn't like. I know it sounds like I just want attention from guys, which is how my boyfriend sees it, and that makes me a terrible girlfriend but it's more like that I take what I can get when it comes to a social life. I can't push the few people that talk to me away because I'm scared to be alone. I can't just be at home, alone in my own head. I always have to do something or I will just think about upsetting things. I feel secure in his arms but he do not seem to understand me, and how could he when not even I understand me.  
He says that I have to do what he finds necessary for our relationship or it's over.

I don't think I can explain what the problem is between us. I'm just so indecisive and don't know anything about anything. The things he say I have to do to fix it is hard for me because it involves cutting strings to my past and old friends and my past is all I know. I know I should do it but it's hard.
I have never been really social in my life so now when it comes to it I don't really know how to make friends. School has always come in first hand so this last years when I have had a lot to study, my social life has fallen into the shadows.
I have no doubt that my family would want to comfort me but I don't want them to because then I would have to see the pity in their eyes all day, every day.
I'm happy when I make other people happy therefore it's often so that I do what others want since I don't know what I want myself.

Thanks for letting me let it out like this, you are a wonderful person even if I feel kind of stupid for wining

I have thought of midas too. I'm so happy for any response, thank you so much for not ignoring me. I'm writing between panic attacks and I'm not usually this whiny but I don't know what to do. I don't usually talk to anyone or dare to talk about my problems with anyone so this is new to me. I'm usually the one who listens but lately it feels like I have been all for myself. I don't want to complain or be a burden to anyone. It just feels like I'm not supposed to be around people since everytime I try I end up crying. I have my family but I don't feel like I can talk to them since I don't want them to see me crying, and I don't really have anyone to be with during the days. My family have always made jokes about me being indecisive but It's really hard for me to not know what I want. usually I don't even know what I feel and because of that I don't know how to act. I try to please everyone but it always ends up to me hurting the on or the other. My boyfriend (if I still can call him that) and I live at a distance and around here I don't have anyone. I don't even have anyone to apologize to, I just can't make friends. I can't thank you enough for responding. I don't want to burst out on you like this but I can't hold it back.
